name: Network Spell Book
author: Wizard-NetEng
description: A reference grimoire for network engineering tools in the bar: a curated catalog grouped by purpose, showing what is installed on this machine, what each tool does, and a starter command you can copy to the clipboard. Read-only by design — it never runs a network tool.

barWidget.description: Catalog of network engineering tools with capabilities and starter commands

schema.label: Show tools that are not installed
schema.description: Keep uninstalled tools visible so the catalog doubles as a shopping list. Turn off to see only what this machine can actually run.

schema.label: Re-scan interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often to re-check which tools are installed. Only runs after the popup has been opened at least once.

schema.label: Open with all sections collapsed
schema.description: Show only category headers when the popup opens, so you drill into one area at a time.
